exampleEn: She hit the ground running on her first day at the new job.
exampleKo: 그녀는 새 일자리 첫날부터 즉시 효과적으로 시작했다.
gameExamples: The team needed to hit the ground running to meet the tight deadline.
With her previous experience, he was able to hit the ground running in his new role.
To succeed in this competitive market, we must hit the ground running from day one.
